Binary: Google's prebuilt litert_lm_advanced_main (sha256 adac974b…) + 6 .so from gs://litert/binaries/latest/android_arm64/litert_lm/ (object dated 2026-09-18), the same kit as the 2026-10-05 / 2026-10-10 records on this axis. Protocol: the bundle pushed and sha256-read back on the phone, compile/weight caches removed, one warm process (cold engine init), one bench process (--benchmark_prefill_tokens=256 --benchmark_decode_tokens=64 --num_iterations=3 --max_num_tokens=1280 --report_peak_memory_footprint=true), one prompt process ('What is 17 times 23?', --max_output_tokens 400 / 1024 for the 4B); figures = median of iterations 2–3; a 2-second sampler beside each process (MemAvailable guard < 400,000 kB). Galaxy S26 GPU, 4B mixed_int4: the engine builds, but its ~75 s compile heats the GPU past its throttle point (kgsl 1300 → 160–1100 MHz, 78–83 °C) before the iterations, and every process re-initialises on this binary (cache DATA_LOSS), so the throughput figures are thermally capped; round 1 (phone at thermal status 0) and round 2 (status 2 after another lane's legs) are both kept in metrics. Figures = round 2 (10:57–11:08 JST, thermal status 2 at start); round 1 in metrics.round1_*.
